metadata.description: LitFamily extensions: content-production skills that install alongside the LitFamily products, one plugin per family.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: lit-pptx: finished PowerPoint decks from a request, notes or source files, with its own office runtime.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: lit-docx: finished Word documents (.docx) from a request, notes or source files, plus DOCX/PDF to Markdown and in-place edits, with its own office runtime.

plugins.name: figures
plugins.description: lit-diagram-drawer, lit-schematic and lit-scientific-visualization: conceptual diagrams, physical schematics and publication plots of measured data, with the scientific-visualization source the plot skill adapts.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: frontend-ui-ux and visual-qa: interfaces built from a locked house style and design kit with a responsive interface probe, and verification of a built interface with captured screenshots and evidence.

plugins.name: video-covers
plugins.description: lit-typographic-motion and readme-studio: finished short films and silent README cover loops, made from a treatment and checked by their own gate, and factual READMEs with inspected covers. For Claude Code also lit-strobe-reel (strobing type reels), agentvfx (music-reactive VFX clips) and video, the front door that picks among them.

plugins.name: sheets
plugins.description: lit-xlsx (Claude Code only): Excel workbooks with live formulas, from models and budgets to KPI dashboards, recalculated in LibreOffice, audited for formula errors and rendered to a PNG per sheet before delivery, with its own Python runtime.
